# Asset License Manifest

## KayKit Adventurers

- Source: https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-adventurers
- License type: CC0 / free commercial use, per source listing.
- Commercial use: Allowed.
- Attribution: Not required for CC0, but source notes should be retained.
- Redistribution caution: Import only needed working assets into this repo; avoid committing unused full pack contents.
- Intended use: Warrior player visual, basic humanoid enemy visual, and boss placeholder visual candidates.

## KayKit Character Animations

- Source: https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-character-animations
- License type: CC0 / free commercial use, per source listing.
- Commercial use: Allowed.
- Attribution: Not required for CC0, but source notes should be retained.
- Redistribution caution: Import only needed animation clips/controllers into this repo; avoid committing unused full pack contents.
- Intended use: Idle, move, attack, dodge/evade, hit, and death animation candidates for humanoid visuals.

## Kenney Tiny Dungeon

- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/tiny-dungeon
- License type: CC0, per Kenney asset listing.
- Commercial use: Allowed.
- Attribution: Not required for CC0, but source notes should be retained.
- Redistribution caution: Import only the small prop/environment subset needed for the current arena; avoid committing unused full pack contents.
- Intended use: 3-5 lightweight dungeon arena props and simple environment dressing.

## Mixamo Animation Fallback

- Source: https://helpx.adobe.com/creative-cloud/faq/mixamo-faq.html
- License type: Royalty-free commercial use with Adobe/Mixamo terms; not CC0.
- Commercial use: Generally allowed under Mixamo terms.
- Attribution: Check current Adobe terms for project requirements.
- Redistribution caution: Do not redistribute standalone source animation assets or broad downloaded packs. Use only if KayKit lacks a needed animation and keep imported clips scoped to this project.
- Intended use: Optional fallback for missing humanoid animation clips only.
